messages:
sasha: quick thread — i'm dropping a compact Partner Success Matrix + SLA negotiation starter. goal: agree what PMs can promise vs. what's a partner opt-in. comment inline please.

michael: this is great. quick Q: how do we define "rollback" operationally? immediate model switch or rate-limited fallback?

ana: research asks that we tie quality gates to paired-eval thresholds and require partners to submit representative prompts that define regressions.

ravi: runtime POV: rollback should be an immediate routing to fallback variant + short circuit (60s) then controlled ramp. we need an API flag for manual rollback.

emily: CS asks for a one-page "success playbook": onboarding checklist, weekly sync template, incident escalation path, and partner telemetry consent.

jen: legal: for Dedicated/Private customers, many will ask for a residency/data addendum. recommend a short templated addendum to avoid 3-week review cycles.

sasha: draft matrix (compact):

```
PARTNER SUCCESS MATRIX (draft)
- Onboard time: first successful inference <= 48h from activation
- Active signal: >= 3 inferences/day avg by end of week 2
- Observability: token-level latency + per-route error budget visible in console
- Quality gate: paired-eval win-rate >= 90% over 50-sample paired tests
- Operational SLO: p95 latency within agreed per-partner SLO; otherwise auto-fallback to hosted
- Rollback policy: manual API flip + auto-circuit on error-rate > 5% for 5m (tunable per partner)
- Exit criteria: partner NPS >= 7 AND submission of 2 prioritized prompts for product tuning
```

michael: minor tweak: make the error-rate trigger configurable; sensitive partners should be able to set to 3%.

ana: also require a primary business contact + infra contact in intake form.

ravi: blocker: we currently lack an exposed endpoint to flip fallback for a single partner; ETA ~10 days to ship a minimal endpoint + test harness.

emily: blocker: CS capacity — without extra SE hours we can support up to 6 concurrent partners. need to confirm headcount or reduce cohort size.

jen: blocker: ClearBank/legal-heavy partners should be marked standby; timeline likely 3+ weeks for signoff.

sasha: proposed owners: michael (partner comms + SLA doc), ana (paired-eval + rubric), ravi (rollback API + harness), emily (CS playbook + staffing), jen (legal addendum). please ack and add any missing blockers.

michael: ack. i'll produce an SLA doc draft and partner-facing one-pager by Monday.

ana: ack. will share the paired-eval rubric link when ready.

ravi: ack. will open a feature branch and PR for the rollback endpoint.

emily: ack. i'll map SE availability and propose a support rota.
